summary:
AbbVie第二季財報營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於預期，年增率達10.16%，顯示核心業務動能強勁。
• 營收達169.9億美元，較去年同期成長10.16%
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為3.65美元，優於市場預期的3.61美元
• 核心免疫學與神經科學產品組合持續展現穩健需求
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報優於預期展現基本面韌性，對短中期股價具正面支撐；後續應追蹤暢銷藥品銷售成長率及新藥研發管線進展。

需留意：高達72.63的本益比可能隱含較高的估值壓力；面臨主要藥品專利到期的長期替代競爭威脅

summary_en:
AbbVie reported second-quarter revenue and EPS that both beat expectations, with 10.16% YoY revenue growth, demonstrating robust core business momentum.
• Revenue reached $16.99B, representing a 10.16% increase year-over-year.
• EPS came in at $3.65, beating the consensus estimate of $3.61.
• Core immunology and neuroscience portfolios continued to show solid demand.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings beat demonstrates fundamental resilience, providing positive support for the near-to-mid term stock price; key metrics to track include flagship drug sales growth and pipeline progress.

Watch：A trailing P/E ratio of 72.63 may imply elevated valuation pressure.; Long-term generic and biosimilar competition risks facing key mature drugs.
